messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a sharp drop in reserved GPU pool utilization in us-west-2 starting ~17:00 UTC. We're falling back to on-demand for ~22% of inference traffic. Cost spike visible in Cost Explorer :eyes: https://ce.aws/console/shortlink

samir: Can you paste the CE query / granularity so we can pinpoint which SKU and tags?

maria: Raw filter I used:
```
Service = EC2
Region = us-west-2
UsageType IN (GPUHours, BoxUsage:p4d.24xlarge)
Tag:owner IS NULL OR Tag:owner = "unknown"
TimeRange = last 6h
```
Results: ~3k GPU-hours untagged, reserved utilization for p4d in us-west-2 = 68% (threshold 85%).

cost-bot: Alert: ReservedCapacityUtilization(region=us-west-2,instance=p4d.24xlarge) = 68% (threshold 85%). Triggered at 2026-02-11T17:08Z.

lucas: Could this be leftover from the eu->us traffic redirect we did last week? Tagging pipeline had that one deploy.

maria: I dug in — 3 specific instance ids show owner tag cleared right after the deploy: i-0a1b2c3d4e, i-0f9e8d7c6b, i-0d4c3b2a1f. Tagger Lambda errored on HTTP 500 during rollout window.

anya: Repercussion = on-demand fallback and loss of committed coverage. Finance note: a 22% fallback on these SKUs is non-trivial.

kevin: I can remediate tags and drain nodes if we want to reprovision into reserved pool. Give me a greenlight. ETA ~45m.

finance: Please escalate — if this persists past billing cutoff we could see ~+$30k/mo delta vs plan. Need quick mitigation and forecast.

samir: Short-term options: 1) retag + drain -> reclaim reserved capacity (preferred), 2) move some workloads to us-east reserved capacity (latency tradeoff), 3) buy short-term Savings Plan top-up (procurement overhead).

maria: Let's retag + drain first. If utilization doesn't recover to >=85% within 24h we consider a temporary SP top-up.

kevin: Starting remediation now. Commands I'm running:
```
# retag instances
aws ec2 create-tags --resources i-0a1b2c3d4e i-0f9e8d7c6b --tags Key=owner,Value=ml-platform
# cordon + drain
kubectl cordon gpu-node-23
kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

maria: thanks. I've opened a scrub job and link to ticket: https://rwd/ops/1234. Also adding alert rule: untagged_gpu_percent > 0.5% for 30m.

lucas: Also add a monitoring check for tagger Lambda errors (5xx count) and a synthetic that validates owner tag on newly launched instances.

kevin: remediation logs:
```
2026-02-11T17:12:03Z tagger-lambda ERROR 500 when patching i-0a1b2c3d4e
2026-02-11T17:25:41Z tagger-lambda RETRY success, owner=ml-platform applied
2026-02-11T17:28:09Z kubectl drain gpu-node-23: evicted pods, node ready for reprovision
```

maria: Action items (assignments):
- kevin: finish retag & drain, verify reserved pool sees reclaimed instances (in progress)
- samir: update cost model + scenario for SP top-up if utilization stays low (standby)
- lucas: add tagger/5xx alert and synthetic tag validation (low effort)
- finance: prepare quick forecast for +$30k delta and approval path for emergency SP purchase

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 created, assigned to kevin, priority=P2.

maria: I'll monitor metrics and post updates. If utilization back to >=85% I'll close the incident. Thanks all :thumbsup:
